exercise.prompt:
Make a report card. Read three marks from 0 to 100, one per line.
1. Print `Total:` and the sum of the marks.
2. Print `Average:` and the whole-number average (use `//`).
3. Print `Result:` and then `Fail` if any single mark is below 35. Otherwise print `Distinction` for an average of 75 or more, `First class` for 60 or more, and `Pass` for the rest.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek report card banao. 0 se 100 tak ke teen marks padho, har line mein ek.
1. `Total:` aur marks ka sum print karo.
2. `Average:` aur whole-number average print karo (`//` use karo).
3. `Result:` print karo, phir agar koi bhi ek mark 35 se kam hai toh `Fail`. Warna 75 ya usse zyada average par `Distinction`, 60 ya usse zyada par `First class`, aur baaki sab par `Pass`.
